sections.text:
[Effects]
The following will activate if your Class is Archer:
Physical and magic Ability Power increases by S - 4XL based on the light elemental attack value.

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.
Only activates when playing as Archer.

[Activation Rate]
S+
Activation rate against Dark enemies increases to M.
